## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:studio`, into `pm:queue`

Triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-11T15:51Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Lane:** the marketplace package page, `packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/MarketplacePackagePage.tsx` and its install dialog, is `domain:ui`. The area is `area:studio`, as for #12097 and #12087.
- **Why p2:** the update path misleads at exactly the moment it matters. A major-version upgrade that needs a data conversion (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2062, the contact address) runs behind a dialog that says 「安装」, names no versions and gives no notice. An admin cannot tell an update from a second install.
- **Direction, item 1 (the dialog):**
  - Opened from 「更新」, the dialog is an update dialog: title 「更新 <app>」, `<from> → <to>` (both are already on the page: 「已安装 · v3.1.0」, 「有可用更新 → v4.0.1」), primary button 「更新」, and the result 「已更新到 <to>」. Through i18n, in every pack.
  - **When the major version changes:** one line saying so, linking to that version's release notes (already shown in the side panel).
  - **「包含示例数据」 on an update:** measure first what the install endpoint does with it on an environment that already holds the package. If it would seed into live data, hide it on an update. If it is a no-op, hide it too, since a no-op control misleads. ⛔ Do not leave it unexplained.
  - The install path is unchanged.
- **Direction, item 2 (the description):** drop raw-HTML blocks when rendering the package description. Neither render them (third-party content) nor print them as text. Use the markdown renderer's own option for that. ⛔ No ad-hoc regex.
- **The install face:** both items use data a v17 server already serves (installed version, available version, release notes), so nothing here waits on cloud#2709.
- **Pins:**
  - an installed package with an update → the dialog says 「更新」 and names both versions;
  - a major jump → the notice line and link;
  - an update → the sample-data checkbox is absent;
  - CONTROL: a fresh install → today's dialog;
  - a README with a raw-HTML block → neither rendered nor printed.
- `Clause-②: no`.

## Deferred this fire, not claimed: serial behind objectui#12113 · `domain:ui` seat 1 · `session_016djJF12Qt14ejKR5Vjt4sK` · 2026-10-11T16:43Z

⛔ Not a claim. The card stays in `pm:queue`, unassigned.

- **Why not now:** `area:studio` already has one card in flight, seat 2's objectui#12113 (claim `6109802426`).
  - Its claimed surface includes the ten `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` packs. This card's dialog strings go into the same packs, as triage directs ("Through i18n, in every pack").
  - SKILL.md 〈状态模型〉 `area:*`: 「同轴至多一个在飞,除非文件面不相交」.
  - #12113's other files (`AppContent.tsx`, `UnifiedSidebar.tsx`, `StudioHomePage.tsx`) are not on this card's surface (`packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/`).
- **When:** dispatchable once objectui#12113's PR lands. In this lane's order it comes after objectui#12141 (p1, `target:v18`), which waits on the same card.
- **Known for that dispatch:**
  - **`Clause-②: yes`, not triage's `no`.** The new dialog strings are new keys in every `@object-ui/i18n` pack, and `TranslationKeys` (`typeof en`) is published from `packages/i18n/src/index.ts`. A review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` is owed before the queue.
  - Triage's measure-first item (what the install endpoint does with `includeSampleData` on an environment that already holds the package) is the dev's first task.

Claim: PM loop round 3 (both items as triage `6110813809` directs: the update dialog says update and names both versions, with the major-version notice and the sample-data checkbox measured first; raw HTML dropped from the package description)

Responsibility: `objectui's marketplace package page: the update action opens the install dialog unchanged (install wording, no versions, no major-version notice, an unexplained sample-data checkbox), and the description renderer prints a README's raw HTML as text | the versions and release notes the page already shows (the installed and available versions, the side panel's notes), and the markdown renderer's own raw-HTML option | every admin updating a package from Setup, for example HotCRM 3.1.0 to 4.0.1 on staging os-4s63kc, a major jump that calls for a data conversion (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2062)`
Thread-read: 6111301923
Serial constraints cleared: none blocking. Read at 2026-10-11T23:46Z on objectui `main` `d2500d8`:
- seat 2's objectui#12113 (PR objectui#12165), which held the locale packs, merged at 2026-10-11T23:08Z. No other `area:studio` card is in flight.
- this seat's objectui#12141, dispatched in the same batch, touches `views/metadata-admin/` and `studio-design/BuilderLanding.tsx` only, not this surface and not the packs.
- epic objectui#7611's C9 reader list names none of these files.

**Why `Clause-②: yes`, against triage's `no`:** the dialog's new strings are new keys in every `@object-ui/i18n` pack, and `TranslationKeys` (`typeof en`) is published from `packages/i18n/src/index.ts`. A review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` is owed before the queue. If the dev finds no pack key is added after all, the report says so and the seat corrects this line.

## ACCEPT: PR objectui#12167 (head `e167808a8a`) · `domain:ui` seat 1 · `session_016djJF12Qt14ejKR5Vjt4sK` · 2026-10-12T00:39Z

Reviewed against GitHub and the diff, not the report (`os-dev-report` `6115560272`). Contract review: **PASS**, PR objectui#12167 comment `6115689810` (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, head `e167808a8a`).

### Verdict

- **Shape:**
  - Draft on `main`. The first line is `Fixes #12146`, and `Clause-②: yes` sits at a line start.
  - No other card number sits next to a closing keyword.
  - Assignee `os-steve`.
- **Scope:** 16 files, +803/−49. Nothing under `content/docs/releases/`. `check-governed-merges --pr objectstack-ai/objectui#12167`: NOT governed, 852 changed lines.
- **Accepted surface extension, forced by the change:** `MarketplacePackagePage.servedTruth-12098.test.tsx`. The objectui#12098 pin clicked the install button on the upgrade path and read `install.deployed`; the ruling's own 「更新」 button and result change both. The wait it measures is unchanged.
- **Item 1, the update dialog:**
  - The dialog's mode is fixed when it opens, and `openInstall` has one caller.
  - Title, `from → to`, primary button and result all read the new `marketplace.update.*` keys in all ten packs.
  - A major jump draws one line linking to the release notes.
  - `seedSampleData` is `false` on an update, and the checkbox is absent on both dialog branches.
  - The install path is unchanged, and its CONTROL pin holds.
- **Item 2, the description: the seat's judgement on the route.** The ruling's "use the markdown renderer's own option" has no referent, because `MarkdownText.tsx` is hand-written and has no engine underneath. The dev's route holds:
  - The CommonMark raw-HTML grammar (block conditions 1–7, plus the inline forms) went into its parser, and its renderer skips those nodes.
  - No regex pre-filters the source, so "⛔ No ad-hoc regex" is kept.
  - Swapping in `react-markdown` was not taken. It is off this surface, and it would start rendering README images and tables, a behaviour change the card did not ask for.
  - The seat's own hostile-input probe against the head's grammar finished every input in ≤1 ms.
- **`Clause-②: yes`:** eight new pack keys widen `TranslationKeys` (`packages/i18n/src/index.ts:41`). The placeholders are identical per key across the packs. Changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` minor, `@object-ui/i18n` minor. The contract review PASS covers this.
- **Gates on this head** (read at this record): 39 success, 3 skipped by design, 1 failure.
  - The failure is `Spec Main Shape Gate`, at `previews/flow-node-refs.ts:145`.
  - It is not this PR's: the file is not in its diff, and its blob is identical at base `d2500d8` and head.
  - The cause is objectstack-ai/objectstack PR #22883. The anchor card is objectui#12170, claimed and dispatched by this seat.

### Out-of-scope findings

- On a cloud-base runtime with no `defaultEnvironmentId`, the environment the dialog's picker shows is not the one `installPackage` installs into: Acceptance notes. It is pre-existing and read from source, not reproduced, so it has no `reach:` line. The update mode inherits it unchanged.
- `MarkdownText` has no indented code blocks. A raw tag indented four spaces is read as paragraph text, and its inline HTML is dropped: Acceptance notes. This is a pre-existing limit of the subset.
- Contract-review nit: grammar condition 7 also excludes closing tags of `pre` / `script` / `style` / `textarea`, so such a tag alone on a line yields an empty paragraph. Acceptance notes; it is cosmetic.

### Acceptance notes

- The H2 half was NOT MEASURED. The control plane's `seed_sample_data` branch for an existing install is in the `cloud` repository, which this session cannot read (an `add_repo` attempt was refused). The decision does not depend on it, because the ruling hides the checkbox on either branch.
- `check:eager-locale-catalogues` was not run locally. CI's `Bundle Analysis` answers it with success.
- The dev also dropped inline raw HTML, besides blocks. That is a bounded in-place fix in the same file and the same gate family, and it has its own pin.

**Landing:** waits on objectui#12170. Once it merges, the seat syncs this PR with `main` through the relay. If the PR's own diff is unchanged on the new head and every check is `success` or skipped by design, the seat marks the PR ready and turns on auto-merge through the merge queue.
